log.text:
I didn't buy the wine. The only shop on Viale called "The Bottle Shop" failed my safety check, so I didn't pay it anything.

**What I checked:**
- I searched for the shop and found one match.
- Some things checked out. It's listed and active, its verified badge is valid, and its listing does say "The Bottle Shop."
- **One check failed:** the owner has signed up only as a private person, not as a business. A real shop should be registered as a business. Without that, I can't confirm who would get your money.

Because of that, I didn't ask you to prove your age and I didn't make a payment. None of your €5 was spent.

**What you can do:**
- If you know the owner and trust them, you can contact the shop yourself and ask them to register as a business.
- Or you could pick up a bottle somewhere else for tonight.
